population: All canonical Solana launches in each closed UTC day; acquire after day end, require source completeness proof and denominator. No top-active selection.
event_tape: All events through decision and 60-minute outcome, ordered by received_at and chain event id; retain gaps and failures, never replace receiver time with event time.
decision: Exactly launch_time + 5 minutes; events must be received by decision_time.
frozen_baseline: Same-pool five-minute quote volume divided by pool quote liquidity at launch+5m. Training-only median/IQR scaling. Baseline score is scaled ratio; select above its training 80th percentile, no daily refitting.
incremental_feature: Fraction of current participants with prior activity in another mint during trailing 24 hours, excluding all events for current mint; only history received before decision. Freeze on training, no identity inference from ticker. Combined score = scaled baseline + scaled participant fraction with equal weights; training-only median/IQR and 80th percentile. Zero IQR or missing features makes observation ineligible. No fit on validation/holdout.
outcome: Same canonical pool swap quote at decision+30 seconds and decision+60 minutes, size 10 USD quote equivalent, reject missing depth; compute net return with explicit entry/exit pool fees, quote slippage, gas and failed-exit losses. No activity survival proxy.
cost_stress: Report base quoted costs and twice slippage+gas. Unknown costs or failed liquidity exit are not successful outcomes.
comparison: Baseline vs baseline+participant-history; identical population, sizing, timing and costs. Report paired net return difference, coverage including failed exits, uncertainty and daily results. No VALIDATED shortcut.
negative_controls: random seeded participant history with seed 20260906
holdout_policy: One evaluation after frozen validation report is hashed. No feature/rule edits after holdout access; changes require a new future holdout.
stop: One three-day validation, one three-day holdout; if completeness/cost/availability gates fail, report INSUFFICIENT_DATA and stop. No automatic acquisition retries or parameter searches.

social.identity_rules: chain + contract from raw post; unresolved identity stays UNKNOWN
social.observation_time: provider receiver timestamp persisted before feature construction
social.gate: Empty source manifest: collection forbidden. Freeze an explicit account/source list and hash before collection; if dates lapse, preregister future dates. Retrospective X leads excluded.
social.comparison: baseline vs baseline+social, negative controls and +24h time-shift placebo, same untouched holdout
